metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: AGUQUR crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P 1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C47 H75 Eu3 N9 O17 1+,6.25(C1 H4 O1),N1 O3 1-,0.25(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.573-3.584 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 94.73-97.54°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C47H75Eu3N9O17. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 3 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
